review_notes:
I read the whole file. I looked at every definition: ζ, zL, wL (an abbrev), lev, BL, famB, and the scoped instance instCommRingChart. I checked whether any of them competes with an existing Mathlib concept.

- ζ is a composite of Spec.map of the quotient map with ιFin. zL is a pullback.map assembled with pullbackSpecIso and pullbackSymmetry. Neither is a parallel version of a Mathlib notion. They are project-specific constructions with their own API: the range and disjointness lemmas, and ζ_toBase and zL_snd.
- lev, BL and famB are abbrevs that name Ideal.span {aeval v p} and TensorProduct. They are short naming conveniences, not new concepts.
- wL is an abbrev for curveChange. That definition lives in Definitions/Def_AlgebraicGeometry_RelPicardPullback.lean, not in this file.
- instCommRingChart restates Subalgebra.toCommRing, which Mathlib already provides as an instance (Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/Subalgebra/Basic.lean:283) and which this file does not disable. The two are definitionally equal. I found no concrete cost such as incompatibility or conversions, so I did not report it.
- finite_bc, etale_bc and rankAtStalk_bc are theorems and are excluded by the rubric.

I am fairly confident in this verdict. The remaining uncertainty is whether the scoped CommRing instance is needed for elaboration. I did not test that.
